_comment: Steepest 100 m of each climb as published by climbfinder.com (its 'steepest 100 metres' / 'steepest segment' figure), for the side and start the app uses. build.py caps the profile at max(this, the steepest published km of Routes.kt) + 1.5 points and its gate fails a profile whose steepest 100 m exceeds that + 2 points or 25 %. A stage has no single published maximum; its entry lists climbs instead ("climbs": name, foot and summit waypoint names, max100Pct, source), and only those stretches are capped and gated. "capPct" (with "capReason") sets the fit's cap directly for a route without a published steepest 100 m; "capSections" (name, fromWaypoint, toWaypoint, capPct, capReason) caps a stretch of a stage the same way, without gating it.

climbs.name: Grand Ballon
climbs.fromWaypoint: Grand Ballon – foot of the climb (cat. 1, 21.5 km at 4.8 %)
climbs.toWaypoint: Grand Ballon (cat. 1) summit – Col du Grand Ballon
climbs.source: https://climbfinder.com/en/climbs/grand-ballon-cernay (D431 via Vieil-Armand and Col Amic, steepest 100 m 9.1 %)

climbs.fromWaypoint: Col du Page – foot of the climb (cat. 2, 9.8 km at 4.7 %)

climbs.name: Col du Haag (Voie Verte)
climbs.fromWaypoint: Col du Haag – foot of the climb (cat. 1, 11.2 km at 7.3 %)

champs-elysees.capReason: No published steepest 100 m for the Paris lap. Its only climb, the 1.3 km up to the Arc de Triomphe, is 'not a steep climb' (https://zwiftinsider.com/route/champs-elysees/); the DEM rises ~25 m on it (~2 %). Allowed steeper, the fit turned the building-cluttered DEM of the upper Champs into 4 % steps.

capSections.name: Souloise descent to the Pont de la Baume
capSections.capReason: no published figure; the road loses ~90 m between the D937 north of Saint-Disdier (~1008 m) and the Pont de la Baume (~917 m) over 1.3-1.5 km (~6-7 %), while GLO-30 reads the rim of the Souloise gorge beside it (a 37 % cliff in the researcher's build, a 400 m stretch at the 16 % class cap after it)

climbs.source: https://climbfinder.com/en/climbs/alpe-d-huez (the climb route alpe-dhuez: the 21 hairpins from Le Bourg-d'Oisans, as on the stage; steepest 100 m 11.3 %)
